files.README.md:
# Dunmoor Precision Engineering - quality workspace

Working area for the quality team.

- quality/  the approval list and the gauge register

The approval list names one role per check and is edited in place, so a check is never signed off by two roles. Rows are kept in the order the checks were added to the list, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-04-02, reference DP-9034.
